exam.name: AWS Certified Developer - Associate
exam.overview: For developers with at least a year of hands-on experience building and maintaining AWS applications. Covers developing with AWS services and SDKs, deploying applications with CI/CD, securing code and data, and troubleshooting and optimizing applications.

exam.name: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
exam.overview: A role-independent, entry-level exam for people with up to six months of AWS exposure. Covers the value of the cloud, the shared responsibility model, security best practices, core compute, network, database and storage services, and billing and pricing.

exam.name: Claude Certified Architect - Foundations
exam.overview: For solution architects who design and build production applications with Claude. Tests judgment on tradeoffs across Claude Code, the Agent SDK, the Claude API and MCP: agent orchestration, tool design, prompting and structured output, and context management. Anthropic recommends about six months of hands-on experience.

exam.name: Claude Certified Associate - Foundations
exam.overview: For professionals who use Claude as a productivity tool (operations, marketing, project management, education, communications), not for developers building on the API. Covers prompting, evaluating outputs, designing workflows, choosing models and features, responsible use and troubleshooting. No prerequisites.

exam.name: Claude Certified Architect - Professional
exam.overview: For practitioners in an architect role who choose models, architectures and API patterns, and integrate Claude into enterprise systems with evaluation, security and governance in mind. Anthropic recommends three or more years in systems architecture or platform engineering, plus six months of production experience with LLM systems.

exam.name: Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer
exam.overview: For people who deploy and secure applications and infrastructure, monitor operations across projects, and keep solutions at target performance, using the console and the command line. Google recommends six months of hands-on Google Cloud experience, with no prerequisites.

exam.name: Claude Certified Developer - Foundations
exam.overview: For technical professionals who build, integrate and ship production applications, agents and workflows on Claude. Weighted toward applications and integration, with model selection, prompt and context engineering, tools and MCP, and security. Anthropic recommends one to five years in software engineering plus six months with LLM systems.

exam.name: Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
exam.overview: A hands-on exam for Kubernetes administrators: tasks run on live clusters from the command line, not as multiple choice. Covers cluster installation and configuration, workloads and scheduling, services and networking, storage, and troubleshooting, which carries the largest weight (30%). The questions here practice the concepts, not the live-terminal format.

exam.name: Scaleway Professional: Solution Architect
exam.overview: For experienced architects who know the Scaleway ecosystem. Validates the ability to design IT solutions by identifying, evaluating and combining Scaleway resources into scalable, resilient architectures, including security, sovereignty and sustainability. Scaleway recommends the Foundations and Product certifications first.

exam.name: Scaleway Foundations
exam.overview: An entry-level certification for new Scaleway users (decision makers, consultants, architects, DevOps and sysadmins, developers, students). Covers cloud concepts and Scaleway products: choosing the right product for a use case, billing and cost estimation, and building scalable, secure and highly available infrastructure.

exam.name: Scaleway Associate: Security and Identity
exam.overview: For people who manage access for developers or invited partners and protect sensitive data on Scaleway. Covers organizations and projects, IAM, sharing and encrypting secrets, access to encrypted data in Object Storage, and monitoring for unauthorized activity.
